run_publish_model: run the publish_model script to process a PyTorch checkpoint for publication
run_process_checkpoint: run process_checkpoint to remove optimizer data and save a cleaned checkpoint file
run_parse_args: run parse_args to parse input and output checkpoint filenames from command line
refactor_process_checkpoint: refactor process_checkpoint to also remove sensitive metadata from the checkpoint before saving
review_process_checkpoint: review process_checkpoint to understand how it strips optimizer state and renames files with SHA256 hashes
